reading_guide: a rate is how often the campaign itself breaks the rule
severity is derived from the rate and is never chosen by hand
a rule with no grade here cannot be enforced at all

aquatic-sprite-is-under-water.statement: an aquatic tile belongs in a sector that is under water

blocked-wall-not-invisible-kerb.statement: a wall that blocks the player should either show why or stand at a drop they would not try to step

ceiling-mover-is-not-open-to-the-sky.statement: a Z-motion door that opens by lifting its ceiling cannot have a parallax one

dude-carries-an-xsprite.statement: a sprite on the dude list must carry an XSprite

exit-switch-wears-the-exit-tile.statement: the switch that ends the level wears the tile that says so

flat-tile-power-of-two.statement: a floor or ceiling tile must have power-of-two sides

floor-aligned-sprite-rests-on-a-surface.statement: a flat sprite is a plate and lies on a floor or a ceiling

glass-is-breakable.statement: a pane of glass should be a wall the player can shoot out

keyed-door-says-which-key.statement: a door that wants a key carries that key's emblem near it

link-marker-carries-an-xsprite.statement: a room-over-room marker must carry an XSprite

link-marker-is-paired.statement: an upper link marker needs a lower one sharing its link id

lintel-continues-the-facade.statement: the band above an opening is made of the wall it is cut in

marker-names-a-real-owner.statement: a marker sprite's owner must name a sector that has an XSECTOR

mask-tile-off-plain-surfaces.statement: a tile carrying the mask colour never goes on a floor, a ceiling, or a one-sided wall's picnum
mask-tile-off-plain-surfaces.source: NBlood/source/build/src/engine.cpp:2902 ceilscan and :3000 florscan call the opaque hline path; transmaskwallscan (:3362) is reached only for masked two-sided walls. knowledge/blood/design/owner-anchors-v1.json reading_guide.transparency

masked-wall-not-faking-stone.statement: a masked wall should be something you look through, not stone

open-neighbours-share-a-sky.statement: two open sectors that touch should hold their sky at one height

opening-clears-a-standing-body.statement: a way through is at least one standing body tall

parallax-wears-a-sky-tile.statement: a parallaxed surface wears a tile from the sky family
parallax-wears-a-sky-tile.source: NBlood/source/build/src/engine.cpp parallaxtype handling; knowledge/blood/design/usage-kinds-v1.json sky_family, 1768 parallaxed campaign surfaces

pressed-switch-is-in-reach.statement: a switch worked by hand hangs where a hand can reach it

sky-is-never-below-a-roof.statement: a sector open to the sky must hold its ceiling at least as high as any roofed neighbour's

sky-tile-is-parallaxed.statement: a sky-family tile on a surface carries the parallax bit
sky-tile-is-parallaxed.source: NBlood/source/build/src/tiles.cpp:281 tileUpdatePicSiz with engine.cpp:2951 ceilscan; knowledge/blood/design/usage-kinds-v1.json sky_family.used_without_parallax

sprite-drawn-square.statement: a sprite is normally drawn with equal repeats

stack-portal-wears-the-mirror-tile.statement: a sector carrying a stack marker must wear the mirror tile on the surface the stack looks through

texture-continues-across-a-join.statement: where a material meets itself at a vertex the texture continues at least as often as the weakest campaign map does

threshold-follows-the-roofed-side.statement: a small sector joining an open space to a roofed one usually takes the roof

tile-sits-in-an-attested-slot.statement: a tile goes in a slot the campaign is attested to use it in
tile-sits-in-an-attested-slot.source: knowledge/blood/design/usage-kinds-v2.json (walls, by rendered band) and usage-kinds-v1.json (surfaces and sprites), 43 campaign maps

transmitter-reports-an-edge.statement: a sprite that transmits must report its ON or its OFF edge

two-sided-wall-is-reciprocal.statement: a two-sided wall and its partner must point at each other

wall-between-rooms-is-not-paper.statement: the mass between two rooms is at least 128 units thick

wall-draws-its-own-tile.statement: a wall's picnum is drawn on some band, from one side or the other

wall-tile-is-drawn-somewhere.statement: a tile authored on a map's walls is on screen somewhere in that map
